chapter: Mario Bauza and the Cuban sextets
title: Joining Maria Teresa Vera's septeto as maraca player
summary: After 1926 Mario worked at casinos while Machito played maracas with Maria Teresa Vera; he got the job through Miguelito Garcia.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Okay. Ah - you and Mario never made it to Panama. What did you do after that in 1926?
1926? Well, Mario was working with Jose Curbelo's father at the Summer Casino for two years and then he worked at The Montmatre.
And what - and then what were you doing about that time?
By that time I was playing with Maria Teresa, with Miguel Zavayas, with Sexteto Nacional......
Okay. Maria Teresa Vera happened to be one of the best groups or conjuntos in Cuba. Correct?
Yes
Well, how would you describe her? Un conjunto?
No, it was a septeto.
Septeto. She sang - her popular forte was danzon, danzonete?
No, no, we was singing boleros and guarachas and son montuno......
Ah - Ha, so she was a vocalist then.
Yes
Okay
And Miguelito Garcia was the second voice and Miguelito Valdes was the bass player, I was the maracas player, Julio Biaggi........
How did you get in her group?

Because Miguelito Garcia is from my neighborhood, from Jesus Maria, and one day I was working, like you say, in Jones Beach, and he went out there and saw me playing the maracas and I am supposed to be one of the best; they had one of the best, but the fellow was - he had no - he wasn't too well organized, he always come late or whatever and those particular hits, I mean group, maracas are very important, is the rhythm. So he used to come late, today, tomorrow, the day after tomorrow, whatever, and they was fed-up with the lateness so on account that I was young and ambitious, that I had some kind of, I wasn't .........
You were a good maraca player.
Oh, yes.
Okay
Definitely
Then, you got the job?
I got the job. So, but before that, he saw me working, but one day I was substituting Machin.....
Antonio Machin?
Antonio Machin, at the Sexteto Agabama. There was Barroso and Machin, there was........
About what year was this?
That was in 1930.
Okay, let's try and stick around '26.
